reasoning_content: Now let's start systemd. But we're not pid1. We can try `systemd --system` ... it will complain. Let's try.

action.command:
systemctl --version | head -1; echo "---"; nohup /lib/systemd/systemd --system --log-target=console >/var/log/systemd-boot.log 2>&1 &
sleep 5; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1; echo "---"; tail -20 /var/log/systemd-boot.log 2>/dev/null
